newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Marks & Spencer seeks partner in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Marks & Spencer seeks partner in Australia.

text.p: Marks & Spencer Plc said on Friday it had appointed a manager for its Australian office whose first priority would be to find potential franchise partners to help develop a pan-Australia retail business.
The company named Carl Oden as the general manager and said he would be based in Sydney.
Oden's most recent post was in Birmingham where he was a general manager for Marks & Spencer since 1992.
"Australia is a growing market and has the potential to support a major franchise operation," the company's regional director for Asia Pacific, Jim McDonald, said in a statement.
McDonald said the company was looking for expressions of interest from well-established companies who had strong local market knowledge.
"The ideal potential partner may not necessarily be a retailer," he said.
The company said it planned to open its first store in 1998 and was initially targeting Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane where it would be seeking store sites of 1,000 to 1,500 square metres.
Australia's major department store operators are David Jones Ltd and Coles Myer Ltd.
